content.text: Zoie and Aggie invent a pregnancy and baby to lure Alfred home, forcing Jimmy to obtain infants from a Babies’ Home and from a washerwoman. Alfred returns to Chicago, reaches Zoie’s bedroom, and joyfully believes he has twins—eventually three babies—while Jimmy repeatedly carries infants through the hotel, hides in the bedroom, and attempts the fire escape. Police, the babies’ mothers, and Maggie expose the deception; Zoie finally confesses, and Alfred ultimately forgives her. The later natural-history passages describe flies laying eggs in vulnerable parts of carrion, caterpillars blindly following silk trails, Lycosa spiders’ nests and brood-carrying, and Epeira spiders’ elaborate webs, venom, silk traps, and vibration-sensitive “telegraph” lines.
